_doc: Canonical, season-aware F1 personnel graph. people = identity (one record per person, ever). roles = PERSON x ROLE x TEAM x (DRIVER) x SEASON edges with effective dates and sources. A role renders on a constructor page only when display=true, current=true and season matches. Facts are normalised from sources; no prose is copied. Conflicts are recorded, never silently resolved. Unknown = absent (never guessed). Mechanics: only named when a source documents them; otherwise the team record says not_publicly_documented.
